Now attached, three layers: (1) the code — carryForwardStructureSpecKeys (apply_adoption_plan_action.go:1098-1140) merges ALL unknown current-row keys under adoption's fresh write, deliberately not an allow-list ('an allow-list is this same landmine again one flag later'), failing open in every arm; (2) the artefact — probed 2026-08-14 on BOTH running chassis replicas (agent-chassis-699fc7fcbc-thr7v and -v6257): grep -ac 'carryForwardStructureSpecKeys' /proc/1/exe = 2 on each, one-letter near-miss control ('...Keyz') = 0; and git merge-base --is-ancestor 19acfc895 69612d692a4a confirms ancestry of the 08-13 artefact-verified build on a forward-only tree; (3) the corpus — the central LANDMINES entry ('Re-adopting a site silently drops...') was ALREADY corrected on file before round 1 ('FIX COMMITTED 2026-08-11 (19acfc895) ... The canary (canary_replan_407.sh, committed) fires ONE direct build-site-planner orchestration at loancalculator and judges: site_plan_sections rows for the current plan naming tool-% sections on the pages that hold the 12 locked rows; pages-identity md5 unchanged pre/post; locked page_components count and lengths unchanged; the run's own available_components length = 140 (an unflagged control site's next run must show 129).
